name: mesh-gradient-shader
title: Mesh Gradient Shader
summary: A decorative animated color field for expressive backgrounds, powered by Paper Design Shaders.
useWhen: A visual surface needs atmospheric depth behind readable foreground content.
The experience can afford a WebGL-based decorative effect.
avoidWhen: The effect would compete with primary content or reduce text contrast.
The target device or environment cannot reliably support the shader dependency.
capabilities: Animated color spots and organic distortion
accessibility: Treat as decorative and keep meaningful content outside the shader canvas.
Verify foreground contrast against the complete animated background.

motion.purpose: Add slow atmospheric depth without becoming the page's primary action.
motion.reducedMotion: Use a static composition or disable the animated shader for reduced-motion users.
